cases.name: etaf-web-tests-article-ir-elements
cases.purpose: Article HTML compiles into normalized IR with YAML front matter, ATX headings, inline styles, dynamic code-span fences, resolved links, preserved anchors, decodable picture source, figure caption, language-tagged code block, nested task list, definition list, blockquote, rule and GFM footnotes.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-boilerplate-and-density-extraction
cases.purpose: Navigation, sidebars, ads, share bars, newsletter prompts, related posts, comments and footers are pruned; pages without article or main landmarks fall back to text-density extraction.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-details-callouts-and-tables
cases.purpose: HTML details/summary, docs callout classes and ARIA roles, spanned and multi-block pipe tables, and language-less code fences map to etaf-md containers and GFM blocks.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-sanitizes-dangerous-tags-and-links
cases.purpose: Script, style, noscript, iframe, svg, template, event attributes and javascript:/vbscript:/data:text/html links are stripped from the compiled IR.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-open-local-fixture-renders-in-buffer
cases.purpose: Opening a local HTML fixture writes cache files and renders the title, code block and figure caption inside the etaf-md preview buffer.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-url-fetch-caches-and-skips-refetch
cases.purpose: Stubbed HTTP fetch decodes meta charset, writes index.md, meta.json and cached assets while degrading failed images gracefully, and reuses the cached index.md without refetching on repeat open.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-disable-image-downloads-and-error-conditions
cases.purpose: Disabling `etaf-web-download-images' skips image fetches and keeps remote URLs, while invalid inputs and unreadable files signal `etaf-web-error'.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-http-link-navigation-and-anchor-jump
cases.purpose: Inside an `etaf-web-open' preview buffer, activating an HTTP(S) link opens the target page through `etaf-web-open' instead of the external browser while `#anchor' stays in-document.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-deduplicates-leading-h1-only
cases.purpose: A leading `<h1>' whose plain text matches the front-matter `title' is omitted so the title appears once, while mid-body and trailing `<h1>' headings are preserved.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-figure-figcaption-replaces-alt-without-extra-paragraph
cases.purpose: An image `<figure>' with `<figcaption>' emits a single image whose alt is the caption's plain text with no trailing italic caption paragraph, while figures without `<figcaption>' retain their original alt.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-fetch-timeout-and-distinct-errors
cases.purpose: `etaf-web-fetch-timeout' is forwarded to `url-retrieve-synchronously', and HTTP status errors (e.g. 403), timeouts and connection failures each report distinct `etaf-web-error' messages.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-strips-makeinfo-nav-and-permalinks
cases.purpose: Makeinfo Next/Previous/Up navigation blocks, bracket-only navigation link lines, decorative navigation rules and heading permalink `[¶]` markers are stripped while real prose rules and headings stay.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-strips-breadcrumbs-and-anchor-noise
cases.purpose: Breadcrumbs (by nav/crumb class or multi-link separator trail) and short `#anchor'-only decorative paragraphs are removed while real prose and in-sentence anchor links remain.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-lazy-images-and-srcset-max-width
cases.purpose: Lazy-load image attributes (`data-src', `data-original', etc.) override placeholder `src', and `srcset' / `<picture><source srcset>' select the widest decodable candidate.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-prunes-site-tail-noise-without-false-positives
cases.purpose: Disclaimers, button-only complaint bars, share/app-download blocks, link-heavy noise blocks and related/recommended sections are dropped while normal prose mentioning keywords or sharing stays intact.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-deduplicates-title-with-site-suffix-and-prefix
cases.purpose: Leading `<h1>' deduplication strips common site suffixes (` - X | Y', `_X', etc.) and matches prefixes while leaving mid-body `<h1>' headings untouched.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-normalizes-front-matter-dates
cases.purpose: ISO 8601 timestamps, slash-delimited dates and year-month values normalize to `YYYY-MM-DD', while unrecognized date strings stay untouched.

cases.name: etaf-web-tests-cleans-overlong-and-title-duplicate-image-alt
cases.purpose: Image alt text exceeding 60 characters or matching the document title (including stripped suffix) becomes empty, while short distinct alts and `<figcaption>` text are kept.
